# Code graph (auto-generated)
Built by GitHub Actions from this repo's source. Use it instead of reading every file:
1. Read GRAPH_REPORT.md for the main concepts and how they connect.
2. Search graph.json for the function, class or file you need and follow its edges to see what calls it and what it calls.
3. Open source files only at the lines the graph points to.
Edges tagged EXTRACTED come straight from the code; INFERRED or AMBIGUOUS are guesses. The graph can lag the latest commit, so read the file itself if something looks off.
